يستنفون (form X)
# يَسْتَنْفُونَ (yastanfūna) /jas.tan.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
# يُسْتَنْفَوْنَ (yustanfawna) /jus.tan.faw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
